description: This file contains a Python Jupyter notebook that facilitates processing a PDF, generating text embeddings using Google PaLM, and performing question-answering on the content. It includes code for PDF text extraction, splitting text into chunks, generating embeddings, creating a vector store, and querying the content with a language model. It appears to be part of a project aimed at enabling PDF-based information retrieval.

methods.name: split_text
methods.description: Splits raw PDF text into manageable chunks to optimize token size during embedding creation.

methods.name: from_texts
methods.description: Creates a FAISS vector store from text chunks using Google Palm embeddings.

methods.name: similarity_search
methods.description: Searches for documents in the vector store similar to a user query.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the QA chain to generate answers based on retrieved documents.
